name: Compile Time Tracker

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  compile-time-tracking:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install cmake ninja

      - name: Set CPU Governor
        uses: tenstorrent/tt-metal/.github/actions/set-cpu-governor@main
        with:
          governor: performance

      - name: Get Changed Files
        id: changed-files
        uses: Ana06/get-changed-files@v2.3.0
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          filter: '^(.*\.(hpp|cpp|h|c))$'

      - name: Check for Transformer Operation Changes
        id: check-transformer-changes
        run: |
          TRANSFORMER_CHANGED=false
          for file in ${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.added_modified }}; do
            if [[ "$file" == *"transformer"* ]] || [[ "$file" == *"attention_softmax"* ]] || [[ "$file" == *"concatenate_heads"* ]] || [[ "$file" == *"split_query_key_value_and_split_heads"* ]] || [[ "$file" == *"sdpa_windowed"* ]] || [[ "$file" == *"sdpa"* ]] || [[ "$file" == *"sdpa_decode"* ]]; then
              TRANSFORMER_CHANGED=true
              break
            fi
          done
          echo "transformer_changed=$TRANSFORMER_CHANGED" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Run Compile Time Analysis
        if: env.transformer_changed == 'true'
        run: |
          mkdir -p build
          cd build
          cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
          make -j$(nproc) tt-metal-compile-time-tracker

      - name: Run Compile Time Tests
        if: env.transformer_changed == 'true'
        run: |
          cd build
          ./tt-metal-compile-time-tracker

      - name: Upload Artifact
        if: env.transformer_changed == 'true'
        uses: tenstorrent/tt-metal/.github/actions/upload-artifact-with-job-uuid@main
        with:
          path: build/compile_time_results.txt
          prefix: compile-time-results

      - name: Run Model Tests
        if: env.transformer_changed == 'true'
        run: |
          echo "Running model tests for transformer operations..."
          # Placeholder for actual model test commands
          # This would typically run the model tests as specified in the checklist
          echo "Model tests completed"
